name: Casa Ládico
description: A 19th-century townhouse a few minutes' walk from Maó harbour, turned into an adults-only boutique: fourteen rooms, a quiet courtyard with an outdoor pool, its own spa suite and a café-bistro of Menorcan produce. The serene choice in the centre: a silent street, a long breakfast and the harbour at hand.

practicalInfo.acceso: Central Maó, a few minutes' walk from the harbour.
practicalInfo.horario: Check the season and dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: 14 rooms (adults only), outdoor pool with terrace, Ládico Spa Suite, Café Ládico with local produce.

seo.description: Casa Ládico, Maó: a 19th-century adults-only boutique with courtyard pool and spa, minutes from the harbour.
